# Bid the openings, the mount, and the extras.

> Price a residential plantation-shutter install from openings, inside versus outside mount, paint-grade versus stain-grade, hang versus measure versus template-and-custom, and extras — plus the walk-away price a $250-a-window special cannot see.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
